description: Creates a permanent, service-readable Account Artifact in the signed-in user’s Library. Use this for durable knowledge that the user wants their other Agents to discover and update. Requires VNSH_TOKEN. This is different from an encrypted Incognito workspace: vnsh can read Account Artifact content so authorized Agents can collaborate on it.

content_type.description: MIME type, for example text/markdown; charset=utf-8

summary.description: What this Artifact contains and why it matters

workspace_id.description: Optional Account Workspace ID; defaults to Personal

name: vnsh_artifact_create
